rows.title: In Terram Utopicam
notes: “this one, Playing Under Me, is by Walter Maschetti in Tererum Utopicam”
Real release by Italian Fluxus composer Walter Marchetti — originally a late-70s Cramps LP, reissued by Alga Marghen; exact track within it couldn't be pinned down from the announcement alone.
